units.source_text: 吟声异常幽微。

en.t: The chanting voice was extraordinarily faint and delicate.

units.source_text: 夕雾想象音容，不胜喜慰，真个忘记回家去了。

en.t: Yugiri pictured her voice and face, was overcome with joy and comfort, and truly forgot to go home.

units.source_text: 他说：“这真是进退两难了！

en.t: He said, "This is truly a dilemma!

units.source_text: 归路已经失迷，这夜雾笼罩的屋里又不便泊宿，势必被逐客了。

en.t: I have already lost the way back, yet it would be improper to spend the night in this house shrouded in night fog, so I am bound to be turned away.

units.source_text: 我这不惯风流的人，遇到此种情况，不知如何是好。”

en.t: Someone like me, unused to romantic affairs, does not know what to do in such a situation."

units.source_text: 他表示不想回去，并隐约吐露难于禁受的恋情。

en.t: He showed that he did not want to leave, and vaguely revealed a love too difficult to endure.

units.source_text: 几年来落叶公主并非不知道夕雾的心事，但一向只装作不知。

en.t: For several years Princess Ochiba had not been unaware of Yugiri's feelings, but she had always only pretended not to know.

units.source_text: 此时听见他出之于口，表示怨恨，便觉十分讨厌，越发默默不答了。

en.t: Now that she heard him put it into words and express resentment, she found it deeply distasteful and became still more silent, giving no answer.

units.source_text: 夕雾叹息一声，心中反复寻思，觉得此种机会不易再得。

en.t: Yugiri sighed once and turned it over again and again in his heart, feeling that such a chance would not easily come again.

units.source_text: 他想：“即使被她看作没良心的轻薄儿，也无可如何了。

en.t: He thought, "Even if she sees me as a heartless, frivolous man, there is nothing I can do about it now.

units.source_text: 至少总得教她知道我多年以来恋慕之心。”

en.t: At the very least, I must make her know the love I have cherished for so many years."

units.source_text: 便召唤随从。

en.t: He then summoned his attendants.

units.source_text: 右近卫府的一个将监，最近晋爵五位的，是他的亲信，此人应召来前。

en.t: A lieutenant of the Right Palace Guards, recently promoted to the fifth rank and trusted by him, came forward in response to the summons.

units.source_text: 夕雾吩咐他道：“我有要事，必须与这位律师晤谈。

en.t: Yugiri instructed him, saying, "I have urgent business and must speak with this monk.

units.source_text: 但他此刻正在祈祷，不得空闲，不久就要休息的。

en.t: But he is praying at the moment and has no time; before long he will be resting.

units.source_text: 我今夜准备在此泊宿，等到初夜功德完毕后到那边去见他。

en.t: I intend to stay here tonight, and after the first-night rites are finished I will go over there to meet him.

units.source_text: 叫某某人等在此伺候。

en.t: Have so-and-so and the others remain here in attendance.

units.source_text: 其余随从都到附近栗栖野的庄院中去，在那边取秣喂马。

en.t: Send the rest of the attendants to the nearby estate at Kurusuno, and have them get fodder there to feed the horses.

units.source_text: 不可让许多人在这里吵闹。

en.t: Do not let a crowd of people make noise here.

units.source_text: 在这种地方泊宿，深恐外人知道了以为轻率，会乱造谣言呢。”

en.t: If I spend the night in a place like this, I greatly fear that outsiders will hear of it, think me rash, and spread all sorts of rumors."

units.source_text: 将监心知话中有因，便奉命退去。

en.t: The lieutenant understood that there was a reason behind these words, accepted the order, and withdrew.

units.source_text: 夕雾若无其事地对侍女们说：“这等大雾，归途实在模糊难辨，今夜我只得在此借宿了。

en.t: Yugiri said casually to the ladies-in-waiting, "With such a thick fog, the way home is truly blurred and hard to make out, so tonight I have no choice but to lodge here.

units.source_text: 既然如此，就让我宿在这帘前吧。

en.t: Since that is so, please let me sleep here before this curtain.

units.source_text: 等到阿阇梨休息时，我就去会他。”

en.t: When the acharya has retired, I will go to meet him."
